decisions.reason: As a recently launched camera closely aligned with the firm's proven optical heritage and growing demand for navigation and observation payloads, its value is still unfolding and the option is worth keeping open.

The modular navigation camera fits the firm's strategic move toward more flexible spacecraft sensors, so with high uncertainty but strong strategic fit management would continue the product rather than abandon it early.

The sensor suite extends the firm into an adjacent but attractive space situational awareness area, and for a large R&D-intensive firm the learning value justifies keeping it on the market while demand becomes clearer.

Although the miniaturized LiDAR appears less established commercially than the other launches, it matches the trend toward compact space-qualified sensors and is still better treated as an option to retain than to drop immediately.
